title: Muscle Loss Can Reach 35% By Age 80
hook: Muscle mass can fall 35% by the oldest point shown.
closing: Strength work matters because the decline accelerates later in life.
question: How often do you train for strength?

segments.say: Muscle mass can fall 35% by the oldest point shown. That makes preserving strength increasingly important.
Muscle loss reaches 18% per decade in the later group. The decline accelerates with age.
After training, clinical muscle loss fell to 0% in this study. Resistance work changed the measured outcome.
